implementation: Class-private copyReceivedView is reachable only after private receivedDocument verification and durable/preview binding.
Coarse blocks, locks and fine tiles copy at most 16 items before a real setTimeout yield; fatal and pending identity are checked before/after callbacks, each yield and before publication.
Full durable views reuse the same method; the existing legacy delta branch preserves its previous bounded copy semantics.
Public document verification, framed packet checks, preview binding, cancel forwarding and Worker authority remain unchanged. No trusted flag, skip-validation API or transactions change.

scopes: Generation and constraints preview each copy 33 real encoded/decoded fine tiles in 16+16+1 timer batches; public-clone spy proves no public re-entry after complete.
Returned maps, both fine arrays, coarse values, locks, manifest and preview metadata may be mutated without changing real Owned confirmation and durable IDB restore.
A real timer closes the client during the second fine-copy batch; no partial preview/current replacement or durable root change.
Corrupt final fine fragment is rejected before private copy or preview publication; durable backup bytes stay unchanged.
tests.fixtureBoundary: Generation geometry is explicitly synthetic transport data; codecs/hash checks, receiver validation, binding, Owned replacement, constraints session, IDB commits and restores are real. This is not generator/browser acceptance.

noPerformanceClaim: This removes duplicate public ingress from verified private bridge views. It does not repair or certify public dense ownership before first await, nor the 250/500 ms gates.
dependencies: Staging intentionally contains only the two owned files. Run with root-coordinated staging resolution or after verified controlled promotion, against the current production dependencies.
warning: Vite emitted a configLoader native-extension compatibility warning for the staging config import. It did not affect resolution or execution; no suppression flag was set.
staticScope: Only the two owned virtual production paths and their current transitive imports, plus src/vite-env.d.ts; not a whole-project typecheck.
